title: ビジネス — Business
summary: A business reading for JLPT N2 practice.
summary_en: A business reading for JLPT N2 practice.
summary_id: A business reading for JLPT N2 practice.

paragraphs.text: その話は誤解を招きかねない。
paragraphs.translation: That story might cause misunderstanding.
paragraphs.translation_en: That story might cause misunderstanding.
paragraphs.translation_id: Cerita itu mungkin menyebabkan kesalahpahaman.

paragraphs.text: 彼の話を信じずにはいられなかった。
paragraphs.translation: I couldn't help but believe his story.
paragraphs.translation_en: I couldn't help but believe his story.
paragraphs.translation_id: Aku tidak bisa tidak mempercayai ceritanya.

paragraphs.text: 相手に応じて話し方を変える。
paragraphs.translation: Change the way you speak depending on the other person.
paragraphs.translation_en: Change the way you speak depending on the other person.
paragraphs.translation_id: Ubah cara Anda berbicara tergantung pada orang lain.

paragraphs.text: 実際の経験に基づいて書いた。
paragraphs.translation: I wrote it based on actual experience.
paragraphs.translation_en: I wrote it based on actual experience.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya menulisnya berdasarkan pengalaman nyata.

paragraphs.text: 社長に代わって挨拶する。
paragraphs.translation: Give a speech on behalf of the president.
paragraphs.translation_en: Give a speech on behalf of the president.
paragraphs.translation_id: Memberikan pidato atas nama presiden.

paragraphs.text: 親の期待に反して、芸術家になった。
paragraphs.translation: Against my parents' expectations, I became an artist.
paragraphs.translation_en: Against my parents' expectations, I became an artist.
paragraphs.translation_id: Bertentangan dengan harapan orang tuaku, aku menjadi seorang seniman.

title: がくじゅつ — Academic
summary: A academic reading for JLPT N2 practice.
summary_en: A academic reading for JLPT N2 practice.
summary_id: A academic reading for JLPT N2 practice.

paragraphs.text: 彼はまるで専門家かのように説明した。
paragraphs.translation: He explained as if he were an expert.
paragraphs.translation_en: He explained as if he were an expert.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia menjelaskan seolah-olah dia adalah seorang ahli.

paragraphs.text: 全国にわたって調査を行った。
paragraphs.translation: We conducted a survey across the whole country.
paragraphs.translation_en: We conducted a survey across the whole country.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kami melakukan survei di seluruh negeri.

paragraphs.text: 英語に加えて、フランス語も勉強している。
paragraphs.translation: In addition to English, I also study French.
paragraphs.translation_en: In addition to English, I also study French.
paragraphs.translation_id: Selain bahasa Inggris, saya juga belajar bahasa Prancis.

paragraphs.text: 入社に際して、誓約書を提出した。
paragraphs.translation: I submitted a pledge when joining the company.
paragraphs.translation_en: I submitted a pledge when joining the company.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya mengajukan janji ketika bergabung dengan perusahaan.

paragraphs.text: 都市化に伴って、緑が減っている。
paragraphs.translation: As urbanization progresses, greenery is decreasing.
paragraphs.translation_en: As urbanization progresses, greenery is decreasing.
paragraphs.translation_id: Seiring dengan kemajuan urbanisasi, lahan hijau semakin berkurang.

paragraphs.text: この本をきっかけに、歴史を勉強し始めた。
paragraphs.translation: This book was the opportunity for me to start studying history.
paragraphs.translation_en: This book was the opportunity for me to start studying history.
paragraphs.translation_id: Buku ini adalah kesempatan bagi saya untuk mulai mempelajari sejarah.

title: ニュース — News
summary: A news reading for JLPT N2 practice.
summary_en: A news reading for JLPT N2 practice.
summary_id: A news reading for JLPT N2 practice.

paragraphs.text: 遅れたら、怒られかねない。
paragraphs.translation: If I'm late, I might get scolded.
paragraphs.translation_en: If I'm late, I might get scolded.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jika saya terlambat, saya mungkin akan dimarahi.

paragraphs.text: 3年にわたって研究を続けた。
paragraphs.translation: I continued the research for three years.
paragraphs.translation_en: I continued the research for three years.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya melanjutkan penelitian selama tiga tahun.

paragraphs.text: 収入に応じて支出を決める。
paragraphs.translation: Decide expenses according to income.
paragraphs.translation_en: Decide expenses according to income.
paragraphs.translation_id: Tentukan pengeluaran berdasarkan pendapatan.

paragraphs.text: 出発に際して、一言ご挨拶させていただきます。
paragraphs.translation: On the occasion of our departure, please allow me to say a few words.
paragraphs.translation_en: On the occasion of our departure, please allow me to say a few words.
paragraphs.translation_id: Pada kesempatan keberangkatan kami, izinkan saya menyampaikan beberapa patah kata.

paragraphs.text: 彼に代わって、私が出席した。
paragraphs.translation: I attended in his place.
paragraphs.translation_en: I attended in his place.
paragraphs.translation_id: Saya hadir menggantikan dia.

paragraphs.text: 留学をきっかけに、日本語が好きになった。
paragraphs.translation: Studying abroad was the trigger that made me love Japanese.
paragraphs.translation_en: Studying abroad was the trigger that made me love Japanese.
paragraphs.translation_id: Belajar di luar negeri menjadi pemicu yang membuat saya menyukai bahasa Jepang.

title: いけん — Opinion
summary: A opinion reading for JLPT N2 practice.
summary_en: A opinion reading for JLPT N2 practice.
summary_id: A opinion reading for JLPT N2 practice.

paragraphs.text: 夢を見ているかのようだ。
paragraphs.translation: It's as if I'm dreaming.
paragraphs.translation_en: It's as if I'm dreaming.
paragraphs.translation_id: Seolah-olah aku sedang bermimpi.

paragraphs.text: 海岸に沿って走る。
paragraphs.translation: Run along the coast.
paragraphs.translation_en: Run along the coast.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jalankan di sepanjang pantai.

paragraphs.text: 値上げに加えて、サービスも悪化した。
paragraphs.translation: In addition to the price increase, service also deteriorated.
paragraphs.translation_en: In addition to the price increase, service also deteriorated.
paragraphs.translation_id: Selain kenaikan harga, pelayanan juga menurun.

paragraphs.text: 辞職に至った経緯を説明する。
paragraphs.translation: Explain the circumstances that led to the resignation.
paragraphs.translation_en: Explain the circumstances that led to the resignation.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jelaskan keadaan yang menyebabkan pengunduran diri tersebut.

paragraphs.text: 人口の増加に伴って、問題も増えた。
paragraphs.translation: Along with the increase in population, problems also increased.
paragraphs.translation_en: Along with the increase in population, problems also increased.
paragraphs.translation_id: Seiring dengan bertambahnya jumlah penduduk, permasalahan pun semakin meningkat.

paragraphs.text: 環境問題をめぐって議論が続いている。
paragraphs.translation: Discussion continues regarding environmental issues.
paragraphs.translation_en: Discussion continues regarding environmental issues.
paragraphs.translation_id: Diskusi terus berlanjut mengenai masalah lingkungan.
